# openprovider_domain_price (Data Source)

Reads what an operation on a domain costs, without ordering it, so a configuration can use the price, for example in a budget check or an output.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# What a registration of example.com for two years costs.
data "openprovider_domain_price" "registration" {
  domain = "example.com"
  period = 2
}

# What a transfer costs.
data "openprovider_domain_price" "transfer" {
  domain    = "example.com"
  operation = "transfer"
}

output "registration_price" {
  value = "${data.openprovider_domain_price.registration.price} ${data.openprovider_domain_price.registration.currency}"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) The full domain name, for example `example.com`.

### Optional

- `operation` (String) What to price: `create` (registration, default), `transfer`, `renew` or `restore`.
- `period` (Number) The period in years. Defaults to 1. A transfer is always priced for one year.

### Read-Only

- `currency` (String) The currency of `price`.
- `id` (String) The domain name, the operation and the period.
- `is_premium` (Boolean) Whether the domain is a premium domain.
- `price` (Number) The amount that is charged to the account: the reseller price where OpenProvider quotes one, otherwise the retail price.
- `product_price` (Number) The retail price.
- `reseller_price` (Number) The price for the reseller, 0 when OpenProvider quotes none.
